tx: How to obtain the griffin feather

Head to the White Wolf Mountain, Grimgnash is located on the northeast corner. The griffin will state that it cannot get to sleep because of the howling wolves and will threaten to eat the player if he doesn't tell a bedtime story. Grimgnash says he loves stories with death, fire and destruction... Tell him a bedtime story by selecting the options which sound the most violent:
• "I've heard you are a great and mighty griffin!"
• "There once was graveyard filled with undead."
• "There lived a skeleton named Skullrot."
• "Skullrot was insane!"
• "Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair."
• "Started to strangle the poor gnome."
• At this point, you can answer with any of the remaining choices.
Once Grimgnash is asleep, steal a feather from the pile next to his nest and go back to Sylas.
Warning: If Grimgnash doesn't like the story, he will hit for 100-200 life points.
The item is relatively easy to obtain, compared to the rest of tasks required for the quest.

tx:
Faiza provides a number of free ushabti depending on the Slayer level. Players earn 25 ushabti for 99 Slayer (required to enter the Sunken Pyramid), one ushabti for each further Slayer level from 100–119, and five for level 120 Slayer, for a total of 50. If players have any earned, but unclaimed ushabti, Faiza will give the players as many as they are owed before proceeding with normal dialogue. A ghostspeak amulet or completion of the hard Morytania achievements is required to speak with her.
Ushabti can be purchased from Slayer Rewards for 20 slayer points each as well as being a possible reward from the Rush of Blood Distraction and Diversion.
sc: Alternatively, placing a filled ushabti in a magical barrier spawns a copy of the creature, which will respawn until removed.
